name: jsettlers-exact-dev-exact
purpose: DEV JSettlers table for planner_pv2_exact (experiments/exact-dev2.json): planner_pv2_exact alone vs three all-SMART JSettlers 2.6.10 robots, base seed 20261117, 1024 games, paired by game name with the other policy's run.
analysis: Paired by scripts/jsettlers_paired.py --alpha 0.05 --expect-games 1024 (reported LCB); the DEV gate is the paired point lift (experiments/exact-dev2.json).
limitations: The patch file is GPLv3-derived and lives only in runs/external (never in this repo); its sha256 is pinned here. all_smart makes every locally started robot use JSettlers' SMART strategy params, including our extrabot's inherited fallback brain.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-10 before any game; fresh base seed 20261117; launch with `uv run --with numpy`.
